findings.description: The Diagram section’s TikZ fence renders the literal source code in the local HTML instead of a diagram. The handlebody cancellation sketch is therefore absent. Confirmed rendering defect.
The Remark’s TikZ fence renders literal commands and labels instead of the one-component +4 surgery diagram. Confirmed rendering defect.
The schematic is shown in a red “diagram failed to render” block containing the complete TikZ source; neither local panel is drawn. This is a confirmed render failure.

Statement and Given text contain unmarked formula notation such as “n≠0”, “P(U)”, “H_i(B;R_n)”, “S³”, “[mu_K]=n[mu_{P(K)}]”, and “Z[1/|n|]”; the HTML displays the ASCII-style indices/variable names literally rather than as math. Confirmed typography/math-markup defect.

The statement displays plain-text notation “P⊂S¹×D²”, “K₀/K₁”, “C_sm”, “C_top”, “C_ex”, and “C^{1/n}” without math markup; category subscripts and exponent syntax remain literal in the local HTML. Confirmed rendering defect.

The statement is a plain-text math run: “P⊂S¹×D²”, “C_top/C_sm”, “Pⁿ”, “⟨Pⁿ(C)⟩/⟨Pⁿ⁺¹(C)⟩”, and “dim_Q(A⊗_Z Q)” retain literal notation and unformatted subscripts/exponents. Confirmed rendering defect.
The title renders “5_2” literally (“Trefoil and 5_2 knot…”); the knot-table subscript is not typeset in the heading. Confirmed heading typography defect.

The statement contains unmarked plain-text algebra notation “CG”, “q>0”, “N G”, and “Tor_q^{CG}(M,N G)”; the rendered HTML leaves the group-ring and Tor indices as literal ASCII. Confirmed math-markup defect.
The equality is typed as plain text “sign_Γ^(2)(X,φ)=sign(X)” and displays with literal underscore/caret syntax. Confirmed math-markup defect.

candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The algorithm is defined by endpoint pairings at a single crossing, and a small diagram would let readers see both the crossing chart and the A/B pairings at a glance. No such diagram is present in this item.
candidate_missing_diagrams.draw_or_check: Show the southwest-to-northeast over-strand with a gap in the northwest-to-southeast under-strand; in separate A and B panels connect left-to-left plus right-to-right (weight A), and top-to-top plus bottom-to-bottom (weight A^-1). Preserve the source’s orientation-preserving coordinate transport convention.
candidate_missing_diagrams.status: editorial candidate; no mathematical error asserted

candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The definition introduces darts, fixed-point-free edge involution, cyclic order, over/under opposite pairs, orientation arrows, and a positive/negative sign convention, but only prose is shown. A local labelled crossing would anchor the many coding conventions.
candidate_missing_diagrams.draw_or_check: One positive and one negative crossing panel; mark four darts clockwise beginning with outgoing over-dart, identify opposite over and under pairs, incoming/outgoing arrows, over-gap, determinant sign, and the passage to the edge involution. Check the displayed convention against the source’s stated outgoing-over dart order.
candidate_missing_diagrams.status: editorial candidate; source conventions are internally explicit, no confirmed error

candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The item defines a knot, oriented normal disk bundle, product tubular map, exterior, boundary torus, meridian, and preferred longitude; the local render has no accompanying diagram.
candidate_missing_diagrams.draw_or_check: Draw K with product tube N(K), exterior E_K, common boundary T_K, a meridian mu bounding a normal disk, and a section curve lambda with p_*[lambda]=1 and i_*[lambda]=0. Label the ordered basis ([mu],[lambda]) on T_K.
